<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Devices limit reached</span></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Users limit reached</span></div>

## Why it happens

The tenant profile sets the maximum number of devices, assets, customers, users, dashboards and rule chains. The tenant has reached it. This is a tenant profile limit, not a licence limit ([ST-LIC-003](/docs/troubleshooting/errors/st-lic-003/)).

## Fix it

Delete items you no longer need, or ask the system administrator to raise the limit in the [tenant profile](/docs/user-guide/tenant-profiles/).

## Check that it worked

The item is created.
